phases.reviewText:
REWORK — `planJobs` accepts entries with unknown extra fields, although R2 requires normalized jobs as defined by R1, whose job objects contain exactly the five specified fields. `isNormalizedJob` does not verify exact keys, and `{...job}` would also leak extra fields into returned jobs.

The recorded test execution genuinely passed all 10 tests, but this requirement is untested and the implementation is not contract-complete.

scope: CLI implementation and independent same-model review; supervising subagent/root/setup attribution separate, not an invoice or full workflow savings
